name: system_state

provenance.source: exact 3.1.28 IDB vela_ap.bin.i64 (NuttX assert paths, PowerManager, MiWearScreen, system_all_state, kvdb property client, LVGL lv_timer and bts_adapter review)

notes: Pointer to the system_all_state struct, NULL until system_init_state runs. Byte +1 is the MiWear connection state (1 down, 2 up). Read-only. The getter 0xc38cd4c is NOT recorded: it copies a 256-byte result into its out buffer, not the 8 bytes the Supervisor passes. Supervisor platform service; static evidence only, device NOT_PROBED.
